notes: Deploy IMD6900RobinhoodLaunch from src/IMD6900RobinhoodLaunch.sol on Robinhood Chain with the accepted source and compiler settings unchanged. The first argument is the owner, the team wallet 0x35da9c0303507ddf708e87f2568eddf12c47a059, written as the static address the brief states; the remaining arguments are the Uniswap v4 PoolManager, the old IMDSTR token and the Robinhood timelock, in that order. The constructor creates only IMD6900LockedPool, with static POOL_FEE 44400 (4.44%), and requires no salt mining. After deployment, the team separately calls createHook with a salt mined for the launch address and exact hook permissions, excluding addresses starting with 0x91; the timelock owns the hook. Later, the owner calls launch with a mined 0x6900 coin address to create IMD6900, open its permanently locked pool and execute the opening buy. These later operations are not part of this deployment manifest.
